content_candidate_types.definition: Video answering a specific repeatable how-to task using reproducible steps
Explanation of a stable concept that can receive repeat searches
Instruction dependent on named software/hardware version; demand and accuracy may decay after updates
Time-bounded news/event explanation rather than a presumed evergreen control

protocol.comparison_scope: match topic, geography, language, format, publication period and video age before inferring persistence
protocol.privacy_controls: do not collect searcher accounts or suppressed one-off search terms

invalid_inferences: Studio 28-day trend rankings are not absolute numbers of searches, buyers or future audiences.
More views from YouTube Search does not prove the video is evergreen unless repeated windows across meaningful time are observed.
Older videos have had longer to accumulate lifetime views than recently uploaded videos; raw lifetime totals are not valid like-age comparisons.
Owner-only traffic-source metrics cannot be inferred for an arbitrary public competitor channel or from its publicly visible viewCount.
In-platform search referrals, suggested videos, browsing, external links and Shorts-feed traffic must not be pooled into an assumed search demand statistic.
The 50,000 API video-days request budget concerns query support, not the number of views, videos worldwide, or sampling confidence.
Low or absent Trends content gaps may reflect eligibility, user saves, supported device, geography or suppression; unknown cannot be treated as zero searches.
Search attention is not verified advertising revenue, completed purchases, creator hourly profits or guaranteed tutorial demand.
